name: Okta — Successful Login From Multiple External IPs
xql_query:
dataset = okta_sso_raw
| filter eventType = "user.session.start" or eventType = "user.authentication.sso"
| alter outcome_result = arrayindex(regextract(outcome, "\"result\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0),
        ip = arrayindex(regextract(client, "\"ipAddress\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0),
        user_name = arrayindex(regextract(actor, "\"alternateId\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0),
        country = arrayindex(regextract(client, "\"country\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0)
| filter outcome_result = "SUCCESS" and ip != null and user_name != null
| filter not (ip contains "192.168." or ip contains "10." or ip contains "172.")
| filter not (user_name contains "svc-" or user_name contains "api-" or user_name contains "default.user")
| alter ip_16 = arrayindex(regextract(ip, "^(\d+\.\d+)\."), 0)
| filter ip_16 != null
| bin _time span = 30m
| comp count_distinct(ip) as ips,
       count_distinct(ip_16) as distinct_networks,
       count_distinct(country) as countries,
       values(country) as country_list, values(ip) as ip_list
       by user_name, _time
| filter distinct_networks >= 3 and ips >= 3
| fields user_name, ip_list, country_list
description: Okta user.session.start or user.authentication.sso SUCCESS for one user from ≥2 distinct non-RFC1918 source IPs within one hour.
alert_name: Okta — Successful Login From Multiple External IPs
